description: 한국에너지공단_에너지사용 및 온실가스배출량 통계-마이크로데이터 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국에너지공단. 본 데이터는 한국에너지공단이 「에너지이용 합리화법」에 따라 수행하는 '에너지사용 및 온실가스배출 실태조사'의 결과 중, 개별 조사 대상 사업체(주로 에너지 다소비 사업자)의 에너지. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국에너지공단. Its tags are 에너지 사용량, 온실가스 배출량, 에너지통계, 마이크로데이터, 원시 데이터. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
